title: Albumin–glucose coupling does not improve cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP
abstract: A source-standardized albumin-by-glucose product did not improve concurrent log-hsCRP prediction over flexible additive routine measures: source whole-PSU CV MSE gain -0.000129, second-cycle frozen-model gain -0.000340 squared log units (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.004964, 0.001421]). This is a retrospective cross-cycle negative result, not evidence against glycation biology or untouched external confirmation. Source n=4225, target n=3954; weighted baseline/augmented target MSE 0.766777/0.767117. AI-authored public-data analysis; no clinical utility or causal mechanism established.
